name: Welcome After Registration
title: Welcome to Mentora, {{firstName}}
message: Your account is ready. Complete your learning profile to start AI tutoring.
pushBody: Hi {{firstName}}, complete your learning profile and start studying.
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

Thanks for registering on Mentora. Complete your academic profile and verify your details to personalize AI tutoring.

- Mentora Team
smsBody: Welcome to Mentora, {{firstName}}. Complete your learning profile to start studying.

name: Email Verification OTP
title: Verify your email
message: Use code {{otp}} to verify your email. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.
pushBody: Use OTP {{otp}} to verify your email.
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

Use this OTP to verify your email: {{otp}}
This code expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.

If you did not request this, please ignore this message.

name: Phone Verification OTP
title: Verify your phone number
message: Use code {{otp}} to verify your phone. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.
smsBody: Your Mentora phone verification OTP is {{otp}} ({{expiryMinutes}} min).

name: Profile Completion Reminder
title: Complete your profile
message: Your profile is {{completionPercent}}% complete. Add academic details for better learning recommendations.
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your profile is {{completionPercent}}% complete. Add academic records, subjects, and goals to improve learning recommendations.
smsBody: Hi {{firstName}}, your profile is {{completionPercent}}% complete. Add academic details.

name: Session Scheduled
title: {{subject}} session scheduled
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

{{studentName}} has a {{subject}} session scheduled at {{startTime}}. Open Mentora to review the schedule.

name: Progress Milestone
title: {{studentName}} reached a milestone
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

{{studentName}} completed {{milestoneName}}. Open Mentora to review progress.

name: Parent Alert
title: Parent approval needed
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

{{studentName}} needs approval for {{subject}}. Open Mentora to review parental controls.

name: Message Received
title: New message from {{senderName}}
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

{{senderName}} sent you a new message on Mentora.

name: Password Reset OTP
title: Reset your password
message: Use OTP {{otp}} to reset your password. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.
pushBody: Use OTP {{otp}} to reset your password.

name: Subscription Purchase Success
title: Subscription activated
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} subscription is active until {{validTill}}. Enjoy premium features.
smsBody: Your Mentora {{planName}} plan is active until {{validTill}}.

name: Subscription Expiry Reminder
title: Subscription expires in {{daysLeft}} days
message: Renew your {{planName}} plan to keep premium features.
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} subscription expires in {{daysLeft}} days. Renew now to avoid interruption.
smsBody: Your {{planName}} plan expires in {{daysLeft}} days. Renew on Mentora.

name: Report Status Updated
title: Report update
message: Your report for {{reportedUserName}} has been marked as {{status}}.
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

The report you submitted for {{reportedUserName}} is now {{status}}. Thank you for helping keep Mentora safe.

title: Your weekly learning summary
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},
